paragraphs.text:
The food tasted all right at the time, 
but now your stomach is churning. 
Food poisoning! You’re really sick! 
Make a successful CON roll and go 
on your way, or, if the CON roll is 
failed, spend three hours recovering, 
and mark off 1 hit point. 
Go to any location on the 
appropriate location table:
• New York Location Table.
• Athens Location Table.
• Egypt Location Table. (586)
